project.name: Elenali — Time For You
project.industry: Premium beauty salon (nails, head spa, custom shoe soles)
project.output_style: premium modern 2D motion-design advertisement, beige editorial

assumptions: A1 — No brand colors or fonts were supplied. The palette and fonts below are proposals. Replace them with the official ones if Elenali has them.
A2 — No logo file was supplied. The spec uses a typeset wordmark 'ELENALI' as a placeholder. Swap in the real vector logo, undistorted.

A3 — '4 hands' means two specialists working at the same time, one on the manicure and one on the pedicure. The video says only 'save time'. It never quotes a number of minutes, because none was supplied.
A4 — The custom shoe soles are presented only as 'made to fit you'. There are no medical or orthopedic claims. Confirm the exact wording with the client.
A5 — Prices appear as 'from 400 / 500 / 800 MDL' exactly as supplied. Confirm they are current before release.
A6 — The CTA is Instagram only (@elenalibeautysalon). No address, phone or website was supplied.

A7 — The mascot is an original illustrated woman designed for this video. The client said 'just a woman', so her look is a proposal and can be edited before production (see mascot_direction.character_sheet).
A8 — The voiceover is optional. Every scene works muted, because all key information is on screen.

1_creative_concept.title: Time For You
1_creative_concept.logline: A busy, successful woman has no free slot in her calendar. Elenali gives her time back: two experts work at once, then she gets a head spa reset. She leaves looking and feeling beautiful.
1_creative_concept.big_idea: The calendar is the visual spine of the film. It starts as a crowded grid of grey meeting blocks. The Elenali booking card pushes the grey blocks aside, and one warm beige block reads 'Time for you'. Time is the audience's scarcest resource, so every scene shows time being saved or given back.
1_creative_concept.narrative_arc: Hook (overbooked) → Problem (no time for herself) → Solution (Meet Elenali) → Demo (4-hands manicure + pedicure, then manicure, pedicure, head spa and custom soles) → Payoff (she walks out renewed; calendar reads 'Time for you ✓') → CTA (Book on Instagram).
1_creative_concept.tone: Premium, calm, confident, quietly luxurious. Nothing loud or meme-like. Pacing is fast in the problem section, then slows into Elenali's world.

2_core_marketing_message.one_line: Premium beauty that respects your time.
2_core_marketing_message.remember_this: At Elenali, two experts work at once, so you look beautiful without losing your day.
supporting_points: Manicure + pedicure with 4 hands, at the same time
Custom shoe soles, made to fit you
Clear starting prices: manicure from 400 MDL, pedicure from 500 MDL, head spa from 800 MDL

3_visual_direction.style: Flat 2D editorial illustration with soft paper texture. Clean vector shapes, minimal line work and restrained shading. It should feel like a luxury fashion-magazine layout that has come to life.
principles: Beige-dominant with generous negative space. Luxury means room to breathe.
Large serif headlines are graphic objects in their own right.
Service cards look like thick paper or linen cards with soft drop shadows (2D, not 3D).
Illustrated hands and feet are elegant and simplified, never realistic or clinical.
No stock-photo salon imagery and no sparkles or particles, except one purposeful gold glint on the finished nails (scene 5).
A thin gold hairline rule (1.5px) recurs as a brand signature. It underlines emphasis words and frames the price tags.
3_visual_direction.texture: Fine paper grain overlay at 3–4% opacity across all scenes. Very soft risograph-style tonal shading on the character (two tones per surface, no gradients).

safe_area_1080x1920.rule: Keep all text, prices, logo and handle inside x 90–960 and y 260–1540. Reels/TikTok UI covers the top ~250px, the bottom ~380px and the right ~120px (the action buttons).
safe_area_1080x1920.critical_zone: Place prices and the CTA handle in the middle band, y 700–1400.

4_mascot_direction.role: Protagonist. She is the audience's mirror: the busy woman who finally takes time for herself. She never speaks. She acts and reacts, and the typography and VO carry the words.
4_mascot_direction.personality: Elegant, successful, composed, and slightly overwhelmed at first. Once she is at Elenali she is relaxed, radiant and quietly confident. She is never goofy.

character_sheet.build: slender, tall proportions (head-to-body ratio ~1:8, fashion-illustration style)
character_sheet.face: Simplified editorial face. Almond eyes drawn as two soft strokes with lashes, a small nose line, and dusty-rose lips. Soft blush circles at 20% opacity. No outlines on the face shape; the edges are defined by color alone.
character_sheet.hair: Deep espresso-brown #3B2A22 with one highlight tone #5A4234. Worn in a sleek low bun in scenes 1–6 and 8–10. INTENTIONAL CHANGE: loose and flowing in scene 7 (head spa) to show she has let go.
character_sheet.outfit: A cream oversized blazer #F4EDE3 with a taupe lapel shadow, a camel knit top #C9B29B, straight wide-leg trousers #E6D5C3, nude pointed heels, and small gold hoop earrings #C8A165 (the recurring gold accent).
character_sheet.nails: Scenes 1–2: bare and slightly unkempt, shown subtly and never gross. Scene 5 onward: dusty-rose polish #D9A5A0. The polish change is the visual proof of the service.
character_sheet.props: A phone in scenes 1–2 and 9. A tote bag in scenes 9–10.
character_sheet.silhouette_test: Readable in pure black: the bun, the oversized blazer shoulders and the wide-leg trousers.

consistency_rules: Identical face construction, proportions, skin, hair color, outfit and earrings in every scene.
The only allowed changes are the nail color (after scene 5) and the loose hair in scene 7. Both are story beats.
The same flat 2-tone shading and the same paper-grain texture in every scene.
Create one master turnaround (front, 3/4, profile, back) plus a hands/feet sheet before animating. Every generation prompt references that sheet.
animation_rules: Graceful, economical motion: slow blinks, head tilts, a hand lifting to inspect the nails.
No dancing, winking at camera, exaggerated cartoon squash-and-stretch, or comedic takes.
Her emotional arc is carried by posture: shoulders raised and tense (scenes 1–2) → neutral (3–6) → fully released (7) → tall and confident (9–10).
must_not: She never looks sexualized; poses stay editorial and tasteful.
No realistic rendering. Keep her flat 2D.
Her nails are never shown damaged in an unpleasant way. Scene 2 shows only 'no time', not 'ugly'.
She never holds salon tools herself. The experts do the work.
4_mascot_direction.supporting_characters: The 'expert hands' are two pairs of elegant illustrated hands in cocoa sleeves #6B5446 with gold cuff lines. Their faces are never shown, so the woman stays the only character and the experts read as calm precision.

palette.name: Cream Linen
palette.meaning: Elenali's world: calm, space, luxury. The main background.

palette.name: Stone Grey-Beige
palette.meaning: Busy life. Used only for the calendar blocks in the problem scenes (1–2).

palette.name: Espresso
palette.meaning: Main typography, and the deep-rest background of the head spa scene (7).

palette.name: Champagne Gold
palette.meaning: Value and emphasis: price tags, underlines, highlight words, the '4 hands' mark.

palette.name: Dusty Rose
palette.meaning: The beauty result: nail polish, the 'Time for you' block, blush.

color_rules: Every frame is at least 60% cream or beige.
Gold is used sparingly: at most one gold element per frame, plus the hairline rule.
The espresso background appears only in scene 7, as a deliberate 'lights down' moment.
Nothing is pure white or pure black.

typography.headline: Cormorant Garamond SemiBold (Google Fonts, supports ș and ă). Use the Italic for emphasis words.
typography.support_and_labels: Manrope Medium, letter-spacing +2%. Labels in uppercase at +12% tracking.
typography.prices: Manrope SemiBold with tabular figures. 'from' is set in Cormorant Italic at 60% of the number's size.
typography.emphasis_method: The emphasized word switches to Cormorant Italic and gets a 1.5px Champagne Gold hairline underline that draws left to right in 0.4s.
typography.rules: Headlines are 2–5 words, never paragraphs. Text is Espresso on light backgrounds and Cream Linen on Espresso.

5_color_and_typography_system.font_note: The fonts are proposals (see assumption A1). If Elenali has brand fonts, keep the pairing logic: an elegant serif for headlines and a clean sans for labels.

6_voiceover_script.voice: Female, warm and low-mid register, unhurried, softly confident. Neutral international English with a slight European warmth. Recorded close-mic and dry.

lines.line: Meet Elenali Beauty Salon, in Chișinău.
Manicure and pedicure, four hands at once — so you save time.
And custom shoe soles, made for you.

6_voiceover_script.pronunciation: Elenali = eh-leh-NAH-lee (confirm with client). Chișinău = kee-shee-NOW.

background.environment: An abstract weekly calendar grid (Mon–Sun columns in thin Sand Taupe lines) fills the frame edge to edge.

mascot.pose: Standing at the center, holding her phone at chest height, shoulders slightly raised.
mascot.facial_expression: Focused, a slight frown, eyes on the phone.
mascot.action: Stone-grey meeting blocks drop into the calendar grid around her one after another, snapping in until the grid is full. The last block lands and she exhales, her shoulders sinking.
mascot.interaction: The blocks stack around her silhouette and box her in.

product.content: A calendar full of grey blocks labelled with short real words: 'Meeting', 'Call', 'Kids', 'Flight', 'Report', 'Dinner', 'Gym'.

animation.entrance: Frame 0 already shows her and 3 blocks, so there is no black open. The remaining 11 blocks drop in with 3-frame staggers and a 6% overshoot on landing.
animation.main_motion: The headline 'Your week is full.' types in word by word, synced to the block drops. 'full' lands last in Cormorant Italic with a gold underline.

7_storyboard.transition_to_next: Hard cut on the last block impact to an extreme close-up of her hand and phone (match on the phone).
sound_design: soft paper 'tock' per block (pitched up progressively)
a subtle clock tick bed underneath
a low muted thud on the final block
7_storyboard.generation_prompt: Flat 2D editorial illustration, 9:16 vertical, premium fashion-magazine style, soft paper grain texture. An elegant woman in her early 30s stands in the center, full figure: sleek low espresso-brown bun, simplified almond-eye face, dusty-rose lips, cream oversized blazer, camel knit top, beige wide-leg trousers, nude pointed heels, small gold hoop earrings. She holds a phone at chest height and looks at it with a slight frown, shoulders tense. Behind and around her is a clean weekly calendar grid with thin taupe lines, almost full of rounded stone-grey blocks labelled 'Meeting', 'Call', 'Kids', 'Flight', 'Report', 'Dinner', 'Gym' in small clean sans-serif. Cream #F4EDE3 background, flat two-tone shading, no gradients, no outlines on the face, generous whitespace at the top for a headline. Palette: cream, beige, taupe, stone grey, espresso, one gold accent. Crisp, minimal, luxurious, not cartoonish.
7_storyboard.animation_prompt: The camera pushes in slowly from 100% to 108% over 2.5s. Grey calendar blocks drop into the empty grid cells one by one, landing with a small overshoot, staggered 3 frames apart and getting faster, until the week is full. The woman stays mostly still, blinks once, and her shoulders rise slightly with each block; on the last block she exhales and her shoulders sink. The serif headline 'Your week is full.' appears word by word at the top third. 'full' lands last in italic and a thin gold underline draws beneath it left to right. Smooth, restrained, premium motion; no bounce on the character.

background.color: Stone Grey-Beige #B8B0A7 fading toward Warm Beige at the top
background.environment: Extreme close-up space. The phone screen shows the calendar app.

mascot.pose: Only her left hand, holding the phone. Her thumb scrolls.
mascot.action: Her thumb scrolls the calendar looking for a free slot. Every day is full. She stops, and her fingers relax around the phone.
mascot.interaction: On the phone screen, a small card reading 'Me time' tries to fit into a day, finds no space, and slides out of the grid.

product.content: A phone calendar UI with grey blocks. A dusty-rose 'Me time' card is rejected from the grid.
product.interaction: The 'Me time' card bounces off the full grid and fades.

camera.movement: very slight drift down with the scroll

animation.entrance: A match cut from scene 1's phone. The phone scales up to fill 70% of the frame.
animation.main_motion: The calendar scrolls upward in 2 quick flicks. The 'Me time' card slides in from the right, hits the full column, and slides back out with a small shake.
animation.exit: The camera holds while her natural, unpolished nails stay visible, which sets up the later polish change.

7_storyboard.transition_to_next: A Warm Beige Elenali booking card slides up from the bottom and fills the whole frame, becoming scene 3's background (a card-slide wipe).
sound_design: two soft scroll swishes
a muted 'nope' UI thunk on the card rejection
the clock tick stops abruptly at 4.8s (silence before the reveal)
7_storyboard.generation_prompt: Flat 2D editorial illustration, 9:16 vertical, extreme close-up of an elegant woman's left hand holding a modern phone, seen slightly from above. Warm light-medium skin #E8C4A8, natural nails without polish, a gold hoop earring edge just visible at the top corner. The phone screen shows a minimal calendar app: a weekday column completely filled with stone-grey rounded blocks labelled 'Meeting', 'Call', 'Report', 'Dinner'. A dusty-rose card reading 'Me time' hovers beside the column with no space to fit. Background stone grey-beige #B8B0A7, paper grain texture, flat two-tone shading, clean vector shapes. Headline space at the upper third. Minimal, premium, calm.
7_storyboard.animation_prompt: Her thumb flicks the calendar upward twice and the blocks scroll smoothly; every day is full. A dusty-rose 'Me time' card slides in from the right, pushes against the full column, gives a small shake, and slides back out, fading to 60%. Her fingers loosen slightly on the phone. Serif text appears at the top: 'No time left' on line 1, then 'for you.' on line 2, with 'you' in italic and a gold underline drawing in. The last 0.3s holds in silence.

7_storyboard.voiceover: Meet Elenali Beauty Salon, in Chișinău.

background.environment: A pure graphic space: a tall arched window shape in Warm Beige #E6D5C3 frames the logo. It suggests a salon entrance without depicting a real interior.

mascot.pose: She walks in from the left edge in profile, then stops and turns 3/4 toward the arch.
mascot.facial_expression: Curious, the tension leaving her face, a soft beginning of a smile.
mascot.action: She drops the phone into her blazer pocket as she walks.
mascot.interaction: She stops beside the arch, which glows softly from inside: the Warm Beige turns slightly lighter.

product.content: The ELENALI wordmark (placeholder until the real logo arrives), with 'Beauty Salon · Chișinău' beneath it in Manrope uppercase.
product.interaction: The wordmark reveals letter by letter through a mask rising from the arch baseline.

animation.entrance: The beige card from scene 2 settles, and the arch shape draws itself (a 1.5px gold hairline stroke tracing the arch in 0.6s, then filling with beige).
animation.main_motion: 'Meet' fades up above the arch. The wordmark rises through a mask with 2-frame staggers. The gold hairline underlines it. She walks in and stops at 7.0s.
animation.exit: The arch scales up to fill the frame (the camera passes through it) into scene 4.
animation.easing: mask reveal: easeOutQuint; walk: natural cycle, easeOutSine to stop

7_storyboard.transition_to_next: A scale-through transition: the camera pushes through the arch and the arch interior becomes scene 4's background.
sound_design: a soft airy swell as the arch draws
a single warm chime (felt piano) on the logo reveal — the audio logo
the music kicks in fully here: a warm minimal electronic/lounge beat, 96–100 BPM
7_storyboard.generation_prompt: Flat 2D editorial illustration, 9:16 vertical, symmetrical composition. A tall arched window shape in warm beige #E6D5C3, outlined with a fine champagne-gold hairline, is centered on a cream #F4EDE3 background. Inside the arch is the elegant serif wordmark 'ELENALI' in espresso #3B2A22 with small uppercase sans-serif text beneath it: 'BEAUTY SALON · CHIȘINĂU'. The small word 'Meet' in serif italic sits above the arch. The same elegant woman (sleek low bun, cream oversized blazer, camel top, beige wide-leg trousers, nude heels, gold hoops) stands beside the arch in 3/4 view, gazing at it with a soft beginning of a smile. Paper grain, flat two-tone shading, lots of negative space, luxurious and calm.
7_storyboard.animation_prompt: A thin gold line traces the arch shape in 0.6s, then the arch fills with warm beige. The camera slowly pulls out from 110% to 100%. The woman walks in from the left in profile, slips her phone into her blazer pocket, and stops beside the arch, turning 3/4 toward it; her shoulders drop and relax. The italic word 'Meet' fades up. The letters of 'ELENALI' rise one by one from behind the arch baseline, then a gold hairline underline draws under the wordmark. 'BEAUTY SALON · CHIȘINĂU' fades in below. The arch interior brightens very slightly. At the end the camera pushes forward through the arch.

7_storyboard.purpose: DEMONSTRATION (hero feature) — 4 hands at once saves time
7_storyboard.voiceover: Manicure and pedicure, four hands at once — so you save time.

background.color: Warm Beige #E6D5C3 with a Cream Linen floor plane
background.environment: A minimal, stylized salon: one elegant cream lounge chair with a rounded back, a small side table with a single bud vase, and a footrest cushion. No clutter.

mascot.pose: Seated in the lounge chair, reclined slightly. One hand rests on an armrest cushion and her feet are on the footrest.
mascot.facial_expression: Relaxed and pleased, eyes softly open.
mascot.action: She leans back and settles in. Mid-scene she glances at a small clock icon and smiles.
mascot.interaction: Two pairs of expert hands (cocoa sleeves, gold cuffs) enter from the right edge and the bottom edge. One pair works on her hand, the other on her feet, simultaneously.

product.content: The 4-hands service: two experts working at once. A split graphic shows two dotted timeline bars ('Manicure' and 'Pedicure') that start side by side instead of one after another.
product.interaction: Two gold progress lines labelled 'Manicure' and 'Pedicure' slide in stacked, then fill in parallel at the same speed. A small gold '4 hands' seal stamps into the top-right corner.

camera.shot: MEDIUM-WIDE (woman in chair + both expert pairs)
camera.movement: slow lateral truck left→right, 4% of frame width
camera.perspective: flat layered 2.5D parallax (3 layers: background wall, chair and figure, foreground expert hands)

animation.entrance: Coming through the arch, the background resolves into the salon. The chair and the woman settle into place with a slight bounce-free landing.
animation.main_motion: The expert hands enter at 8.4s and 8.6s and move in gentle, rhythmic, precise loops (filing and buffing gestures). At 9.5s the two gold progress bars appear in the upper third and fill in parallel over 2s. The '4 hands' seal stamps at 10.2s.
animation.exit: At 11.7s the camera cuts in on her hand, which leads into scene 5.
animation.easing: hands: easeInOutSine loops; bars: linear fill with an easeOut on the last 10%; seal: easeOutBack(1.5)

7_storyboard.transition_to_next: A match cut: her hand on the armrest becomes the extreme close-up hand of scene 5, in the same position.
sound_design: soft rhythmic nail-file texture (very subtle, not ASMR-loud)
two synchronized soft 'ding' ticks as the bars start
a gentle stamp sound on the '4 hands' seal
7_storyboard.generation_prompt: Flat 2D editorial illustration, 9:16 vertical, calm luxury beauty salon. The same elegant woman (sleek espresso low bun, cream oversized blazer, camel knit top, beige wide-leg trousers, gold hoops) reclines in a rounded cream lounge chair with her bare feet on a small cushioned footrest. Two pairs of elegant illustrated expert hands with cocoa-brown sleeves #6B5446 and thin gold cuff lines, faces not shown, work at the same time: one pair does a manicure on her right hand, the other pair does a pedicure on her feet. Minimal environment: warm beige wall #E6D5C3, cream floor, a small side table with a single bud vase. In the upper third, two slim horizontal progress bars labelled 'Manicure' and 'Pedicure' sit stacked, half-filled in champagne gold. A small round gold seal reading '4 HANDS' sits at the top right. Flat two-tone shading, paper grain, generous space, serene, premium.
7_storyboard.animation_prompt: Through a gentle 3-layer parallax, the camera trucks slowly left to right. The woman settles back into the chair and her shoulders relax completely. Two pairs of expert hands glide in from the right and the bottom edges and start working at the same time in calm, precise, looping motions: one files her fingernails, the other tends her toes. Two gold progress bars labelled 'Manicure' and 'Pedicure' appear stacked in the upper third and fill in perfect parallel. A round '4 HANDS' seal stamps in at the top right with a soft settle. The headline 'Manicure + Pedicure' appears, then '4 hands. At the same time.' with '4 hands' in italic, gold-underlined. Last beat: 'Save your time.' She glances at the bars and smiles softly.

background.environment: None. Only the hand, a large price card and negative space.

mascot.pose: Her right hand lifts into the frame, fingers gracefully extended and slightly fanned.
mascot.action: A dusty-rose polish sweep wipes across her nails one by one. She turns her hand a quarter turn to admire them.
mascot.interaction: An expert's hand holding a brush finishes the last nail and exits the frame.

product.content: Finished dusty-rose manicure. A Warm Beige price card with a gold hairline frame: 'Manicure' / 'from 400 MDL'.
product.interaction: The price card slides in from the right and rotates from 4° to 0° as it lands.

animation.entrance: A match cut from scene 4's hand.
animation.main_motion: The polish reveal is masked nail by nail over 0.8s. At 13.1s one gold glint travels across the ring-finger nail (the only sparkle in the film). The price card lands at 13.3s.
animation.exit: The dusty-rose polish color expands from the nails to fill the whole frame (a color-field wipe).

7_storyboard.transition_to_next: A dusty-rose color-field wipe radiates from the ring-finger nail, then reveals scene 6 with a match: nail shape → toenail.
sound_design: a soft brush stroke swipe per nail
a tiny crystalline glint on the ring finger
a paper card slide
7_storyboard.generation_prompt: Flat 2D editorial illustration, 9:16 vertical, extreme close-up of an elegant woman's right hand raised gracefully with fingers softly fanned. Warm light-medium skin #E8C4A8 with two-tone shading, perfectly shaped medium-length almond nails in glossy dusty-rose #D9A5A0 polish, and one subtle gold highlight on the ring-finger nail. To the right, a warm beige #E6D5C3 price card with rounded corners and a thin champagne-gold hairline frame reads 'Manicure' in elegant serif and below it 'from' in small italic serif and '400 MDL' in bold clean sans-serif. 7_storyboard.animation_prompt: Dusty-rose polish sweeps across each nail one by one from cuticle to tip, like a mask reveal, over 0.8s; an expert's hand holding a small brush finishes the last nail and slides out of frame. background.color: Dusty Rose #D9A5A0 settling into Warm Beige #E6D5C3 (the rose shrinks back into a circular rug shape)

mascot.interaction: An expert's hand places a folded towel beside her feet and withdraws.

camera.perspective: flat with a subtle ground plane

7_storyboard.generation_prompt: Flat 2D editorial illustration, 9:16 vertical, high 3/4 top-down view of a woman's elegant bare feet resting side by side on a round plush dusty-rose rug, toenails polished in glossy dusty-rose #D9A5A0, warm light-medium skin #E8C4A8 with two-tone shading. background.environment: Darkness with one soft pool of Warm Beige light from the upper left. Concentric water-ripple lines in Sand Taupe at 30% opacity spread slowly behind her head.

mascot.pose: Lying back in profile, head resting over a basin shape, hair LOOSE and flowing down (the intentional change), hands folded on her stomach.
mascot.facial_expression: Eyes closed, completely serene, a faint smile.
mascot.action: She breathes slowly: one visible breath, chest rising and falling. A strand of hair drifts in the water.
mascot.interaction: An expert's hands gently massage her scalp with slow circular motions.

product.content: The head spa ritual, with water ripples standing for calm. A price label in Cream Linen reads 'from 800 MDL'.
product.interaction: The ripples expand outward in slow rhythm with the massage circles.

camera.movement: an almost imperceptible slow drift right, 2%; the most still scene in the film

animation.entrance: The espresso curtain completes and the beige light pool fades up over 0.5s, revealing her.
animation.main_motion: Massage circles loop every 1.2s and the ripples expand in sync. The text appears slowly in Cream Linen: 'Head spa' (17.6s), 'A real reset.' (18.6s), and the price (19.6s).
animation.exit: The light pool grows until it floods the frame back to Cream Linen, like 'waking up refreshed'.
animation.easing: everything easeInOutSine; text fades 0.5s (slower than the rest of the film)

7_storyboard.transition_to_next: A light-flood transition: the warm beige light expands from the upper left and fills the frame, becoming scene 8's cream background.
sound_design: music drops to a filtered pad with the beat removed
soft flowing water
one deep, calm breath (subtle)
the beat returns at 20.8s as the light floods

8_generation_prompts.note: The per-scene generation prompts are in 7_storyboard[n].generation_prompt. Prefix every scene prompt with the STYLE_PREFIX, and attach the character sheet as a reference image for every scene with the mascot.
8_generation_prompts.STYLE_PREFIX: Flat 2D editorial fashion illustration, premium beauty brand advertising, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920, cream and warm beige palette (#F4EDE3, #E6D5C3, #C9B29B) with espresso #3B2A22 typography, one champagne-gold #C8A165 accent and dusty-rose #D9A5A0 details, flat two-tone shading, no gradients, subtle paper grain texture, generous negative space, crisp perfectly legible typography (elegant high-contrast serif for headlines, clean geometric sans for labels), minimal and luxurious, magazine-layout composition.
8_generation_prompts.MASCOT_MASTER_PROMPT: Character turnaround sheet, flat 2D editorial fashion illustration: an elegant woman in her early 30s, slender, tall fashion proportions (1:8 head-to-body), warm light-medium skin #E8C4A8 with shadow #D4A98B, a simplified face with almond eyes drawn as soft strokes with lashes, a small nose line, dusty-rose lips, soft blush. Sleek low bun in espresso-brown #3B2A22 hair. Cream oversized blazer, camel knit top, beige straight wide-leg trousers, nude pointed heels, small gold hoop earrings. Front, 3/4, profile and back views, plus a sheet of hand poses (with bare nails and with dusty-rose polish) and feet. Cream background, paper grain, no outlines on the face shape, two-tone flat shading. Consistent, elegant, tasteful.
8_generation_prompts.NEGATIVE_PROMPT: photorealistic, 3D render, glossy CGI, stock photo, gradients, lens flare, glitter particles, neon, cluttered salon interior, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted text, gibberish text, misspelled words, pure black, pure white, cartoon exaggeration, anime, sexualized pose, clinical or medical imagery, different face between scenes, different outfit between scenes

9_animation_prompts.note: The per-scene animation prompts are in 7_storyboard[n].animation_prompt.
global_motion_rules: Tempo: scenes 1–2 are brisk (the busy world). Scenes 3–6 run at a smooth, confident pace. Scene 7 is the stillest scene. Scenes 8–10 lift in energy, then the final 1.5s hold completely still.
Default entrance easing is easeOutQuint (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)). Camera moves use easeInOutSine.
Text never pops in hard. Words rise 20px and fade in over 8–10 frames with 2–3 frame word staggers.
The gold underline always draws left to right in 12 frames. It is the brand's signature motion.
Only these transition types are used: card slide, scale-through, match cut, color field, light flood, character-driven slide, object morph. There are no generic dissolves.
The character is animated as a 2D cut-out or frame-by-frame hybrid, with smooth weight shifts and no bouncy squash-and-stretch.

10_camera_instructions.summary: A graphic-advertisement camera: it stays restrained, always motivated, and mostly flat, with light 2.5D parallax in scenes 4 and 9.
per_scene: S1: slow push-in 100→108%. The frame tightens as the week fills.
S2: extreme close-up on the phone with a tiny drift down that follows the scroll.
S3: pull-out 110→100%, then push through the arch.
S5: slow push-in on the hand.
S6: high angle, slight tilt down.
S7: near-static with a 2% drift; the stillness is the point.
S8: pull-out 140→100%, from close-up on the foot to the full figure.
S9: slow push-in at a slightly low angle, for empowerment.

12_sound_design.music: Warm minimal electronic / downtempo-lounge at 96–100 BPM, with a soft kick, felt piano, a warm bass and light shaker. Scenes 1–2 have only a ticking-clock bed plus tension (no melody). The music enters fully at the Elenali reveal (5.0s), filters to a beatless pad for the head spa (17–20.8s), swells at the payoff (24s), and resolves on a final chord at 29s. It must be licensed for commercial social use (for example, Artlist, Epidemic Sound or Musicbed).
12_sound_design.audio_logo: A single warm felt-piano chime (a major 9th). It plays at the logo reveals in scene 3 and scene 10.
12_sound_design.sfx_palette: Paper tocks (calendar blocks), soft UI swishes and taps, brush strokes, a gentle stamp, fabric rustle, water, a pen trace, a heel step, a check chime. All SFX are soft, tactile and premium, mixed 8–10 dB under the VO.
12_sound_design.mix: VO -14 LUFS integrated for the full mix, dialogue-first. Duck the music -6 dB under the VO. Master to -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP for Instagram.
12_sound_design.muted_viewing: The film works completely muted: every VO line has an equivalent on-screen headline, and all prices and the CTA are on screen.
